caption: A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The unicycle wheel must be positioned at the edge of the curb to initiate the roll.
The rider must shift their body weight and adjust their posture to maintain balance during the wheel's movement over the curb.
The wheel must roll smoothly over the curb without slipping or losing contact with the ground.
The rider must continue to adjust their position as the wheel clears the curb to remain upright and stable.
